'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**Four [[Burundi]]an soldiers are killed as their vehicle hit a [[roadside bomb]] in [[Burane]], [[Somalia]]. [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] has claimed responsibility for the attack. [https://allafrica.com/stories/202112130356.html (All Africa)]
*Three [[Hamas]] members are killed and six more injured during a dispute with [[Fatah]] gunmen in [[Tyre, Lebanon|Tyre]], [[Lebanon]], at the funeral of a Hamas member killed two days ago during an accidental explosion at the [[Burj el-Shemali]] camp. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/12/12/several-killed-at-palestinian-camp-in-lebanon-hamas-official (Al Jazeera)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Austria]]
****[[Austria]] ends its nationwide [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]] for people who are [[COVID-19 vaccination in Austria|vaccinated]] or who have recovered from [[COVID-19]] as the number of new cases decreases. There will now be an 11 p.m. curfew for restaurants and people must use an [[FFP2 mask]] on public transport and in indoor spaces. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/12/12/austria-ends-covid-19-lockdown-measures-for-vaccinated (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] surpasses 10 million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/russia-registered-covid-19-cases-10-million-2374866 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****The [[United Kingdom]] raises its COVID-19 Alert level to Level 3 due to the rapid spread of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]], which has resulted in 3,137 cases. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20211212-uk-raises-covid-alert-level-due-to-omicron-surge (France 24)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Africa]]
***[[President of South Africa|President]] [[Cyril Ramaphosa]] tests positive for COVID-19 with mild symptoms. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/12/12/africa/ramaphosa-covid-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 Banco de Oro hack]]
**The [[Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas]], the [[Philippines]]' central bank, issues a statement that it is currently monitoring an increase in complaints on [[social media]] regarding [[Banco de Oro]] clients losing money and having their accounts hacked. [https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSL1N2SX018 (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 New Caledonian independence referendum]]
**Citizens in [[New Caledonia]] vote against independence and choose to remain part of [[France]]. Pro-independence parties boycotted the [[referendum]] in order to protest the alleged lack of time to campaign. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/457758/new-caledonia-votes-against-independence-from-france (RNZ)]
